newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain GDP will grow over 3.0 pct in '97 - Montoro.
newsitem.headline: Spain GDP will grow over 3.0 pct in '97 - Montoro.

text.p: Spain's Secretary of State for the Economy Cristobal Montoro said on Tuesday that gross domestic product (GDP) will grow by more than 3.0 percent in 1997.
"To forecast real GDP growth of 3.0 percent is realistic, not optimistic. We believe that at the end of 1997, Spain will grow by more than that," Montoro told a Madrid seminar.
Montoro said the 1997 budget and a likely recovery in other European Union countries would support Spanish growth.
Montoro said the reduction of deficit in 1997 would help to tame inflation.
New measures to be introduced in coming weeks would also help to reduce the inflation, he said.
